Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Frankston South

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Frankston South. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Frankston South, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Frankston South: What We Commonly See

Frankston South is the leafy, hilly side of Frankston, known for larger homes on generous, treed blocks running up towards Mount Eliza and Oliver's Hill. Roofs here are a mix of older roofing on established homes and COLORBOND® on newer builds, often on larger, multi-level rooflines.

The mature gums the area is known for are great for shade but tough on roofs, dropping leaves and bark into gutters and valleys all year. Higher, more exposed blocks also catch the wind off the bay. The jobs we are called out for most in Frankston South are clearing and replacing overflowing gutters, refixing lifted ridge capping, re-roofing, and tracing leaks around flashings.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Frankston South

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Frankston South homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Frankston South

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Frankston South

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Frankston South Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Frankston South Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Frankston South Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
